title: How Tunnels Evolved ⛰️ From Hand Tools to Giant Drills #shorts #engineering
description:
To get past a mountain, you used to go all the way around. From the Greek tunnel dug by hand from both ends, to gunpowder blasting, Marc Brunel's 1825 tunneling shield under the Thames, today's tunnel boring machines, and the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel. Follow for more How It Evolved!
